name: iam-adty/empira-auth
description: Authentication for Empira, as a module: session and bearer guards, a Doctrine User, RequireAuth. Install it only if your application wants it.

extra.//branch-alias: Identical to every other library's, and dev/tools/module-contract checks that it stays identical: one manifest drifting to a different line is otherwise invisible until something resolves against it. No git tag is used, because a tag cannot move and would need a constraint bump and a re-lock in every consumer for each change. 0.x on its own would NOT have worked — Composer parses 0.1.0 as stable, so a 0.x tag would mark a release. See dev/planning/CHECKLIST.md §6.

//repositories: The framework is not on Packagist yet, so it resolves from its GitHub repository. `dev-main` tracks the branch rather than a release, which means a change to principle/main can break this package's install. Do NOT reach for a tag to stage a risky change: a tag cannot move, so every consumer would need a constraint bump and a re-lock for it. Put it on a branch instead — `dev-<name>` resolves like any other branch — and merge when it is ready. A local path repository used to sit here so a sibling checkout resolved without the network; it does not survive a clone, which is what this list replaces. See dev/planning/CHECKLIST.md §6.
